screen: /todo/labels (labels-view.tsx), reached by SPA navigation: / -> Todo -> Filters & Labels -> Manage Labels
navigationNote: A direct goto to /todo/labels rendered an empty root; every reading here was taken after SPA navigation from the app root, per automated-tab-freezes-animations-and-wipes-storage.

create.entryPoint: inline <form> at the top of /todo/labels — no opener button, no dialog
fields: select[aria-label="New Label's colour"] — 20 options, default 'berry red'
input[aria-label="New Label's name"] — placeholder 'New Label', maxLength unset (-1), no character counter
button[type=submit] 'Add' — disabled until the name is non-blank
create.verifiedBy: button[aria-label='Delete Label "zz probe label"'] became visible; sidebar 'Filters & Labels' count went from absent to 1

rename.entryPoint: the row's own input[aria-label='Label name'] — no menu, no dialog
rename.controlType: inline text field, commits on blur
rename.clearMethod: ControlOrMeta+a then Backspace, value asserted === '' before retyping

identityTest.method: Stamped the row's <li> with a data attribute and its <select> with an expando property before the rename. React keys these rows by label.id, so a changed id would unmount the row and drop both marks.
identityTest.verdict: RENAME, not replacement — the same conclusion Todoist's side reached by watching its numeric id 2185032586 survive.

recolour.entryPoint: the row's own select[aria-label='"<name>"'s colour'] — no menu, no dialog

capability.verdict: MATCH — all three exist on a management screen in both apps, which is the nuance's own claim ('not only as a side effect of @name in quick-add').

surface.todoist: All three go through a modal dialog (role=dialog, 'Add label' / 'Edit label'), reached for rename and recolour through the label's options menu -> Edit.
surface.meologue: All three are inline on the list row: an add form, a rename-on-blur field, and a per-row colour select. No dialog is involved at any point.
surface.verdict: DIVERGENT BY SHAPE. Deliberate: labels-view.tsx follows projects-view.tsx's established inline shape so the two screens read alike.

renameIsARename.todoist: same numeric id across the rename
renameIsARename.meologue: same React key / DOM node across the rename

fieldsTodoistHasThatMeologueDoesNot.field: a 0/60 character counter on the name
fieldsTodoistHasThatMeologueDoesNot.note: the one cheap fixable in this row

colourPalette.todoist: Color combobox opening its own role=dialog colour list, default 'Charcoal'
colourPalette.verdict: DIVERGENT — both the widget and the default differ.
